title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
abstract: arXiv:2605.17734v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Equipping LLM agents with reusable skills derived from past experience has become a popular and successful approach for tackling complex and long-horizon tasks. However, such lessons are often encoded as textual guidance that remains largely advisory, lacking explicit mechanisms for when and how to intervene in the agent loop. To bridge the gap, we introduce HASP(Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs), a new framework that upgrades skills into executable Program Functions (PFs). Rather than offering passive advice, PFs act as executable guardrails that activate on failure-prone states and modify the next action or inject corrective context. HASP is highly modular: it can be applied at inference time for direct agent-loop intervention, during post-training to provide structured supervision, or for self-improvement by evolving validated, teacher-reviewed PFs. translated_title: 利用技能程序驾驭LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 为LLM智能体配备从过往经验中提炼的可复用技能，已成为应对复杂长程任务的一种流行且有效的方法。然而，这类经验通常以文本指导的形式编码，在很大程度上仍停留在“建议”层面，缺乏关于何时以及如何介入智能体循环的显式机制。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了HASP（Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs），一个将技能升级为可执行程序函数（Program Functions，PFs）的新框架。PF不再提供被动建议，而是充当可执行的护栏，在易失败状态下被激活，修改下一步动作或注入纠正性上下文。HASP具有高度模块化特性：既可在推理时直接干预智能体循环，也可在后训练阶段提供结构化监督，还可通过演化经教师审核验证的PF实现自我改进。实验表明，与免训练方法相比，HASP带来了显著的性能提升。
tldr: HASP框架将技能从被动的文本建议升级为可执行的程序函数（PF），使其在易失败状态下作为主动护栏干预智能体行动或注入纠正信息，并支持推理时干预、后训练监督与自我改进三种模式，显著提升LLM智能体在复杂长程任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: HASP upgrades skills from passive textual advice into executable Program Functions (PFs) that act as active guardrails intervening at failure-prone states, and supports inference-time intervention, post-training supervision, and self-improvement, substantially boosting LLM agents' performance on complex long-horizon tasks.
